title: Smith Shellnut Wilson ADV Invests $2.42 Million in Apple Inc. (AAPL) -

text:
Smith Shellnut Wilson LLC ADV bought a new stake in shares of Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) in the third 13F & institutional investor bought 10,720 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock, valued at approximately $2,420,000. Apple makes up approximately 2.2% of Smith Shellnut Wilson LLC ADV’s portfolio, making the stock its 11th biggest position.
Several other institutional investors have also made changes to their positions in the stock. United Capital Management of KS Inc. bought a new position in shares of Apple during the third quarter valued at approximately $3,860,000. Pennsylvania Trust Co raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 2.7% during the third quarter. Pennsylvania Trust Co now owns 302,541 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $68,296,000 after acquiring an additional 7,998 shares in the last quarter. We Are One Seven LLC bought a new position in shares of Apple during the third quarter valued at approximately $4,863,000. Nwam LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 4.0% during the third quarter. Nwam LLC now owns 62,258 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $14,054,000 after acquiring an additional 2,384 shares in the last quarter. Finally, Atria Investments LLC raised its holdings in shares of Apple by 3.3% during the third quarter. Atria Investments LLC now owns 110,586 shares of the iPhone maker’s stock valued at $24,964,000 after acquiring an additional 3,519 shares in the last quarter. Institutional investors own 57.08% of the company’s stock.
